patent_grounding.rationale: Revision 3 corrects the previously disconnected auxiliary shaft using the patent's application configuration in which the pulley-integrated clutch is carried on the auxiliary-equipment input shaft: crank torque reaches the outer ring through belt/pulley and the inner ring connects to the auxiliary shaft. Claim-1 single-bearing scope remains explicit. The modeled passive clutch behavior and lower-speed unitary cage coupling are supported. Citations were inspected as passages, not accepted by ID alone.

functional_completeness.rationale: The application torque chain is now continuous: crankshaft to belt to pulley/outer ring, through direction-dependent clutch behavior to inner ring and auxiliary shaft. The previously orphaned bearing-cage flow was removed; coupled cage motion is represented by the connected cage flow. The chosen claim-1 application alternative is coherent.

flow_consistency.rationale: Torque and rotational motion interfaces connect compatible rotational ports, including the newly connected inout inner-ring and auxiliary-shaft ports. The formerly unused bearing-cage item flow is gone; the single coupled-cage flow is referenced at the bearing-cage/clutch-cage interface and its notes convey the lower-speed relationship.

claim_traceability.rationale: The description and behavioral steps track claim 1 and the cited application embodiment, without inventing quantitative speed values or requirements. Claim 2's distinct pair of bearings is explicitly outside the configured model. Claim 4 supports the alternative inner-ring connection chosen here.

interfaces.rationale: The inner-ring-to-auxiliary-shaft interface now connects existing compatible ports and completes the selected application torque route. Other modeled belt, pulley, ring, and cage interfaces likewise join existing ports and are recorded once.

textbook_application.rationale: The model distinguishes physical components and their interfaces and models passive direction-dependent behavior without adding active control or unsupported executable constraints. Retrieved textbook excerpts are tangential and contribute no patent facts; no textbook-based invention claims were made.

summary: Revision 3 resolves both findings from revision 2: the application-level inner-ring/auxiliary-shaft connection is now present and connected using the compatible rotational port, and the orphan bearing-cage flow is removed with its speed/coupling meaning retained in the connected coupled-cage flow. The selected claim-1 configuration and chosen claim-4 application alternative are supported by the inspected patent passages. No remaining evidence, interface, or structural issue was identified; no edits were made.
